# F3 — Network and resource isolation

<!-- Generated from build-standard.yaml by `pnpm gen:standard`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Kind:** Floor (always on)
- **Applies when:** Always (every app). Enforced by the host (S4), not only by app code.
- **Purpose:** A project container cannot reach anything it was not given, and cannot starve the server.
- **Blocks:** preview and live deploys when any check fails
- **Catalogue:** v1.0.0 (ADR-0010)

## Checks

| Check | How | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **F3-1** Probe from inside the project container: Coolify (8000/6001/6002), SSH, the DevOS API, other projects' networks, undeclared tailnet addresses and 169.254.169.254 are unreachable; internet egress works only if declared. | auto | `probe_log` |
| **F3-2** docker inspect shows CPU, memory and pid limits on every project container (DV-NFR-05). | auto | `probe_log` |
